features.description: Exact variant key count, range, white/black pattern, and geometry.
Six ordered sections at documented widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split, continuous chassis.
Stable control IDs, per-section landmarks and density, Program/Synth as the only primary OLEDs.
Pointer/touch/keyboard key press, release, and cancel/blur behavior.
Every visible control moves or presses accessibly and changes presentation state only.
Accessible names, roles, values, keyboard operation, and visible focus.
Note on/off, repeated and overlapping notes, release, all-notes-off, node cleanup.
Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped keyboard with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/sustain, and denied/disconnected MIDI.
Sustain transitions, concurrent voices, deterministic stealing, velocity response.
Truthful loading/ready/error/fallback status; blur/disconnect/unmount stops every owned voice.
No marketing hero, detached rails, missing keys, overflow, or clipped chassis at 1440x900 and 390x844.
Six selectable types; Grand/Upright/Electric are bundled recorded sample sets, audibly distinct, offline, with truthful provenance.
Two-layer enable/focus/level/octave with correct voice ownership and cleanup.
KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res, and Master Level measurably alter rendered audio.
Sustain from UI/keyboard/MIDI honoring SUSTPED; any claimed soft/sostenuto behavior is tested or truthfully labeled an approximation.
Asset failure enters a labeled playable fallback without reporting the primary library ready.
One AudioContext, per-layer buses, ordered effects, master gain/limiter, one destination, cleanup.
Focus follows layers, manual focus, group and global modes, per-unit bypass, all-effects bypass, dry/wet, documented order, delay feedback path, To Rotary.
Every unit and listed type measurably changes rendered audio.
All Phase 1 tests remain present and green.
